title: Honey bees
text:
A honey bee lives in a big family called a hive. One hive can have thousands of bees.

Every hive has one queen. She lays all the eggs. Worker bees do many jobs. Some clean the hive. Some feed the baby bees. Others fly out to find nectar from flowers.

When a worker finds a lot of nectar, she does a dance. The dance tells the other bees where the flowers are.

Bees turn nectar into honey. They store it in small wax rooms. The honey is food for the whole hive in the cold months.
